course_name_original: Pratiques de l'espagnol oral et écrit - MSA
course_name_en: Practices of Oral and Written Spanish - MSA
prerequisites: Students must have studied Spanish for at least three years in secondary education; beginner students in Spanish language-culture cannot enroll in this course.

learning_outcomes.text: Address oral and written Spanish practices, in reception and production, considering the basics of general phonetics and stylistics adapted to the comprehension and production of various literary texts in Spanish.
Acquire production skills transferable to other language cultures where there are points of convergence (especially for European languages and literatures, including ancient languages).
Acquire transferable linguistic competencies (phonology, morphology, syntax, lexicon, philosophy of language).
Acquire specificities inherent to different writing genres through creative workshops.

assessment_rules: Assessment is based on continuous assessment.
